build_audio_transcription_endpoint: build a FastAPI endpoint that accepts an audio file upload and transcribes it using Whisper, OpenAI, Deepgram, Azure, or Mistral
create_text_to_speech_endpoint: create a FastAPI endpoint that generates speech audio from text using OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Azure, or Transformers TTS engines
build_audio_config_management: build an API to get and update text-to-speech and speech-to-text configuration settings for the audio router
test_audio_chunking_and_compression: test splitting large audio files into chunks and compressing them below the maximum file size limit
review_voice_and_model_apis: review the API endpoints that fetch available TTS models and voices from OpenAI, ElevenLabs, and Azure providers
